company.name: Conveo
company.shortDescription: Your AI co-worker designs expert studies, interviews real people and instantly analyzes your videos.
company.description: Conveo is an AI-powered qualitative research platform that helps enterprise teams gather deep customer insights fast. It uses voice and video interviews, not avatars, to capture authentic, human responses. Conveo’s AI then analyzes these multimodal inputs to extract themes, quotes, and actionable insights. Ideal for marketing, product, CX, and innovation teams who want real qualitative data without slow, manual analysis.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $5,300,000, or 91.38% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,893,702 to $22,518,097, a 3.82x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 68 (-8 over 90 days) and market heat at 30 (+0).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
